name: ReferenceInput
description:
Link entities to the one being edited, the way the AI composer adds context: type @ (or
press Link…) to search people, devices, sites, tickets and documents, pick one, and it
becomes a chip. Results group by kind with the current organisation first; chips in the
popup narrow to one kind (Alt ← →). Each chip is the entity's own identity (pass the
application's renderer), removable with ✕ or Backspace, with a relation menu in front of
it. Linking an entity twice flashes the existing chip instead.

Read-only (or `direction="from"` for backlinks) it lists the chips in a recessed well.
signature: <R extends string = string>({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, kinds, source, relations, defaultRelation, currentOrganisation, renderChip, renderGlyph, disabledReason, max, kindFilter, direction, emptyText: emptyTextProp, placeholder: placeholderProp, width, disabled, readOnly: readOnlyProp, invalid, name, id, onBlur, className, ref, ...aria }: ReferenceInputProps<R>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: currentOrganisation
props.description: Results from this organisation come first; others carry their organisation's name.

props.name: defaultRelation
props.description: The relation a new link starts with. Default: the first relation.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: direction
props.description: `from`: backlinks, read with each relation's inverse label. Implies read-only.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Why a target cannot be linked here ("This device"), or nothing.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: What a read-only input with no links says.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid. Pair it with an accessible validation message.

props.name: kindFilter
props.description: Show the kind filter chips in the popup (default when there is more than one kind).

props.name: kinds
props.description: The kinds that can be linked, in the order results group by.

props.name: max
props.description: Most links allowed.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the search input loses focus, so a form can mark the field touched.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with the full, de-duplicated list of links whenever one is added, removed or given
another relation. Pair with `value` to control it; use `defaultValue` otherwise.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: relations
props.description: Relations a chip's menu offers. Omit for plain context chips (the AI composer).

props.name: renderChip
props.description:
Draw a linked entity as a chip. Pass the application's identity (the AI resolver's
chip tier) so a link looks the same here as in an answer. Default: EntityIdentity's chip.

props.name: renderGlyph
props.description: The glyph in a result row. Default: the kind's icon.

props.name: source
props.description: Where

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Available width or named width tier.
